+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Back up the SQLite database via the online backup API and verify integrity.
+
+Usage: python3 scripts/backup_database.py
+"""
+
+import sqlite3
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+DB_PATH = "data/app.db"
+BACKUP_PATH = Path("data/backups/app_backup.db")
+
+
+def backup_database() -> int:
+    BACKUP_PATH.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+    src = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
+    dst = sqlite3.connect(BACKUP_PATH)
+
+    # Online backup API: safe with active WAL (unlike a raw file copy)
+    src.backup(dst)
+
+    # Integrity of the backup copy
+    check = dst.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone()[0]
+    ok = check == "ok"
+
+    # Consistency: row counts and schema must match between live and backup
+    counts_ok = True
+    for table in ("orders", "schema_migrations"):
+        n_src = src.execute(f"SELECT count(*) FROM {table}").fetchone()[0]
+        n_dst = dst.execute(f"SELECT count(*) FROM {table}").fetchone()[0]
+        if n_src != n_dst:
+            print(f"FAIL  {table}: live={n_src} backup={n_dst}", file=sys.stderr)
+            counts_ok = False
+        else:
+            print(f"MATCH {table}: {n_src} rows in live and backup")
+
+    src.close()
+    dst.close()
+
+    if not ok:
+        print(f"FAIL  backup integrity_check: {check}", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+    print(f"OK    integrity_check on backup: ok")
+
+    if not counts_ok:
+        return 1
+
+    print(f"OK    backup written to {BACKUP_PATH} ({BACKUP_PATH.stat().st_size} bytes)")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(backup_database())
